name: 36107 · Montgomery, AL
findings: ZIP 36107 (Montgomery) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36107 (Montgomery) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36107 (Montgomery) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.
